title: Scalar early energy

baseline.label: ΛCDM
baseline.scope: The source retains the conventional cosmological sector and compares EDE fits with ΛCDM. The proposed minimal test uses a matched zero-EDE control; it does not reproduce those fitted cosmologies.
baseline.parameters_reason: No candidate input set is registered. Source illustrative or fitted values are not adopted as prospect parameters.

cosmology.gravity: Conventional Einstein/GR cosmology is the working interpretation of the source CLASS extension; no modified-gravity sector is proposed. Exact implementation still needs inspection.
cosmology.geometry: FLRW background for the proposed test. Flatness is a conventional interpretation of the source six-parameter fit without a curvature parameter, not an explicitly printed metric in this letter.
components: Retained baryons and cold dark matter.
Retained photon/radiation and the source specified free-streaming neutrino sector.
Retained conventional late-time Λ sector; early scalar energy is additional.
modifications: Alternative branch: Hubble-frozen scalar with (1-cos(phi/f))^n potential, followed by averaged oscillatory dilution.
Alternative branch: initially linear potential rolling toward zero, treated in the kinetic n→infinity limit. These alternatives are not two coexisting added fields.
cosmology.background: Source Eqs.(1)-(2) supply a frozen-then-diluting effective density/EOS. The proposed rho-normalized toy test is reviewer derived; Omega normalization and present closure remain unresolved.
cosmology.perturbations: Source model uses effective density/heat-flux perturbations and potential-dependent rest-frame sound speed. The minimal ruler test omits this closure, recombination and the fitted parameter compensation.
observables: Minimal test: rho_phi, H, fractional early energy and fixed-endpoint r_s versus matched zero-EDE control.
Source fit: CMB spectra/lensing, BAO/growth, SN distances and H0 likelihood; no current-data reassessment.

scope: Compare a necessary background ruler response at declared fixed densities, loading and endpoint.
Lost scope: exact scalar evolution/averaging, EDE perturbations, self-consistent recombination/drag and likelihood inference.
No Hubble-tension solution is established by lowering this ruler alone.
unknowns: Exact source Omega normalization and code curvature/density closure.
Detailed slow-roll potential and validity of effective-fluid averaging.
Matched input set, endpoint, implementation, likelihood lineage and unknown shared covariance.

combination_compatibility.basis: Unchecked beyond the explicitly sourced branch; shared topic membership does not authorize mixing mechanisms.
